display_title: Marriage with a Suspiciously Demure Husband

titles.title: Marriage with a Suspiciously Demure Husband
My Demure Husband's Reason for Marriage Is Suspicious
The Suspicious Purpose Behind Her Refined Husband's Marriage
Цель брака моего скромного мужа подозрительна

description:
Hazel Love possessed the body of a character destined to die from overwork, but she defied her fate, quit her job, and established a guild to make a name for herself. On top of that, she married her perfect ideal type, a man who’s handsome, a great cook, kind, and well-mannered. But at night, he’s wild! It was a successful life… until I discovered his true identity. His real name is Kyler Hadid? The ultimate mastermind I’ve been taking advantage of?! 

 *“Tell me you love me.”

“…I love you.”*

A perfect husband who might kill me at any moment. He showers me with affection without even knowing my true feelings. What on earth is his game?! 

Hazel dreams of a safe breakup, but... 

 *“Hey, Noah, about that thing I mentioned the other day…”

“I just hope the words coming out of my darling’s pretty mouth right now aren’t ‘divorce.’ I don’t want to keep you confined to the bedroom.”*

Faced with the smirk in my husband’s eyes, which seemed to radiate murderous intent, I quietly shut my mouth.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
